title: Gen Hoshino Performs Hirayasumi TV Anime's Opening Song
content: The website for the television anime of Keigo Shinzō 's Hirayasumi manga (a co-production with Shogakukan-Shueisha Productions Co., Ltd and Production +h. ) announced on Monday that Gen Hoshino is performing the anime's opening theme song. The announcement did not reveal the song's title.
author: ANN

title: My Crush’s Crush Anime Reveals Teaser Visual, Trailer, Staff, Cast, April 2027 Premiere
content: The previously announced My Crush’s Crush anime revealed a teaser visual and a trailer on Monday. The main staff and cast and an April 2027 premiere date, have also been announced. Studio project No.9 is in charge of the animation. Kazuomi Koga is directing the anime with Yoriko Tomita handling the series scripts.
author: Anime Corner

title: Godzilla Minus Zero Earns Record $32 Million in N. American Opening Weekend
content: Godzilla Minus Zero , the new Godzilla sequel film from Godzilla Minus One 's Takashi Yamazaki , earned an estimated US$31.61 million at the North American box office in its opening weekend. A record 74% of that total came from premium large format screenings, with 40% or US$12 million from IMAX screenings.
author: ANN

title: Netflix’s Most Romantic Christmas Episode of 2026 Is Already Here
content: An ongoing anime currently airing on Netflix has just delivered its most perfect Christmas-themed romantic episode of 2026, and it will be very hard to top anytime soon. As a streaming platform, Netflix has a knack for delivering series that perfectly match the theme of the season.
author: ComicBook

title: AI Controversy Puts Critically Acclaimed Vinland Saga Creator in the Spotlight
content: The creator of the critically acclaimed seinen manga series Vinland Saga , Makoto Yukimura, has found himself caught in an unnecessary AI controversy. Yukimura is one of the most profound storytellers in the manga industry, and Vinland Saga , which ran for 20 years, is proof of that.
author: ComicBook

title: New Dragon Ball Super Remake Gives Super Saiyan God Goku vs. Beerus Major Upgrade
content: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus has finally kicked off the fight between Super Saiyan God Goku and Beerus with the newest episode of the remake, and it’s given the fight a major upgrade compared to what was seen before.
author: ComicBook

title: The Darkest Fantasy of the 2000s Is Making a Huge Comeback on Netflix After 3 Years
content: Black Butler is finally returning to Netflix after it was removed from the platform in October 2023. Among the 2000s anime classics, Black Butler still stands out for its exceptional storytelling and complex characters.
author: ComicBook

title: Avatar: Seven Havens Creator Teases Future Return of the Avatar Cycle
content: Avatar: Seven Havens has wrapped up the first season of its run now streaming with Paramount+, and the co-creator behind the entire franchise has teased that Pavi and Nisha could reconnect with the Avatar Cycle someday despite its current status.
author: ComicBook

title: Godzilla Minus Zero VFX Team Break Down Ghidorah’s Most Challenging Moment in New Movie [EXCLUSIVE]
content: Godzilla Minus Zero officially introduces a new take on Toho’s classic kaiju King Ghidorah, and the visual effects team behind it all opened up to ComicBook all about the challenges of bringing the famous monster to life.
author: ComicBook

title: Major Shonen Jump Series Confirms It Will End After 5 Years With Next Release
content: Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump is gearing up to end its next major series with its final chapter’s release planned after five years of serialization. It’s been a long year of endings within the pages of Shonen Jump magazine, and unfortunately the majority of these endings have been brought about by early cancellations.
author: ComicBook
